summary: Compact tracker used by CS Ops to run a weekly renewal cadence. Focused on ARR hotspots, short window contracts, and playbook recommendations tied to customer health and legal/commercial blockers.
notes: Probability guidance: >80% = internal confirmed + PO in process; 60-80% = verbal yes / exec alignment needed; <60% = at-risk. Health Score combines NPS, usage trends, and support volume (internal metric). 'Days to Renew' is days until Contract End as of last_modified date. Use 'Playbook / Template' to map to CS playbooks library (confluence keys in linked_artifacts). Update row after every owner touch; color-code externally when importing to dashboard: Red(<50), Amber(50-75), Green(>75).
